heading: INT. DENTAL CAR - MOBILE CLINIC TRAIN - NIGHT

units.text: INT. DENTAL CAR - MOBILE CLINIC TRAIN - NIGHT
A converted railway carriage fitted with a reclining dental chair, a tray of instruments, and a hanging lamp.
Rails clatter below.
A window frames the black countryside.
Through it, scattered farm lights wink by.
DR. PERPETUA ACHTERBERG-NWOSU, 50s, in surgical mask and visor, leans over a patient in the chair.
Her hygienist, MARISOL TEAGUE-ROY, 30s, holds the suction.
In the corner, the patient's mother, a WOMAN in a gray coat, clutches a purse.
The patient, a small boy named DESMOND, 7, grips the armrests, eyes squeezed shut.
Open wide for me, Desmond.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: Is it going to hurt?
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: It's going to pinch. Pinch is not hurt.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: It's hurt with a nicer name.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: You're very smart.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: Suction ready.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Thank you. She says it's ready, you hear that?
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: I heard.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: The train rounds a bend.
The instrument tray slides and Marisol catches it with one hand.
Is it a cavity?
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: Two. And a baby tooth that's refusing to leave.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: My husband had one like that.
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: Refusing to leave?
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: Don't get me started.
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: Doctor, she's slid a note under the door. The conductor's.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Tell her I'm elbow-deep in a seven-year-old.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: It says it's urgent.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: It's always urgent. Hold his jaw.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: Holding.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Dr. Achterberg crosses to the door, picks the note off the floor, and reads it.
She returns with her mask pulled down.
Marisol, finish up. Mrs. Okonkwo-Bell, I'll need you in the next carriage.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: Why?
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: The note says your husband is on this train.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: A silence.
The boy opens one eye.
Mom? Is Dad here?
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: No.
units.name: MRS. OKONKWO-BELL

units.text: Then we have a problem.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: Doctor, I haven't seen him in three years.
units.name: MRS. OKONKWO-BELL

units.text: He bought a ticket in your name.
units.name: DR. ACHTERBERG

units.text: That's impossible.
units.name: MRS. OKONKWO-BELL

units.text: Marisol removes the suction.
Desmond sits up.
The woman in the gray coat stands, clutching her purse, and faces the door.
